name: – Pierfrancesco Maran – Commission proposal
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on amending Regulation (EU) No 528/2012 as regards the extension of certain data protection periods
part_text:
The European Parliament has approved, without changes, a Commission plan to extend certain data protection periods under the rules on biocidal products — things like disinfectants and pest control products. Under these rules, companies that submit data to approve a product get a period during which others cannot rely on that data. The report does not spell out the new lengths or which products are covered; it simply backs the Commission's proposal as drafted.

- The protection periods for certain product data would be extended; the exact lengths are not stated in this report.
- It affects companies that make or register biocidal products, and those wanting to use others' data.
- Parliament's first-reading position is set; talks with EU governments come next before it can become law.
